entities.summary: Daniel William Kucera, OSB was an American Catholic prelate who served as an auxiliary bishop for the Diocese of Joliet (1977–1980), Bishop of Salina (1980–1983), and Archbishop of Dubuque (1983–1995). He was a member of the Benedictines.
